messages.subject: [Mvabund-updates] Warning: Suspicious spam and virus attack!
messages.subject_clean: [Mvabund-updates] Warning: Suspicious spam and virus attack!
messages.body_plain:
Dear mvabund users,

You may have received an odd message entitled
1 Mvabund-updates moderator request(s) waiting
from the following address:

 mvabund-updates-bounces at lists.r-forge.r-project.org

This is not from our mvabund-updates administrators, and is highly
suspicious. Please be warned not to click any link contained in that
message to avoid possible infection of computer virus and alike.

Please note that all message from mvabund-update will be in pure text form
and will not contain any links.

Thanks and regards,
Yi Wang
